title: Purview Copilot Audit Watch
blurb: A running record of the Microsoft Learn pages behind Microsoft Purview auditing of Copilot — the Copilot audit events, the audit-log activities catalog, and the search and retention model. Purview audit logs are the primary data source for several of the Hub's reports, so a change to the Copilot audit schema can silently break them.

docs.title: Audit logs for Copilot and AI activities
docs.why: THE definition of the Copilot audit events (what is logged for each Copilot interaction). Reports reading from Purview audit logs depend on this schema.

docs.title: Audited activities (audit log activities catalog)
docs.why: The full catalog of audited activities and their record types. New or renamed Copilot activities appear here and change what can be measured.

docs.title: Search the audit log
docs.why: How analysts query the audit log — the retrieval surface the report pipelines rely on.

docs.title: Learn about auditing solutions in Microsoft Purview
docs.why: Standard vs Premium audit, retention windows, and licensing — gating on how far back Copilot activity can be analysed.
